summary: VEON Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 5, 2026 press release announcing an agreement to make a strategic investment in JungoTV Holdco, Inc., the newly formed Los Angeles-based holding company of Jungo TV. VEON will acquire a 33.75% equity stake plus control rights, combining Jungo TV's content portfolio and distribution across 60+ countries with VEON's digital platforms in Pakistan, Bangladesh, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan and Ukraine. No price per share or total consideration was disclosed; both Jungo TV and the All Women's Sports Network (AWSN, co-founded with Whoopi Goldberg) remain Los Angeles-headquartered under existing US management. Watch for closing conditions and governance terms embedded in the 'control rights' language.
